MiniHack-Room-15x15-Allocentric-v0 is minihack_levels' twin of MiniHack-Room-15x15-v0 with pixel_crop fixed on the level's map, so the level holds still and the agent moves; room15x15_egocentric.json plays MiniHack-Room-15x15-v0 itself, the egocentric view, a 9x9 window centred on the agent.
